name: application-form-success-panel
title: Form Success Panel
description: A post-submission confirmation panel with a success icon, message, and next-step actions, at full-page and compact card scale with an optional numbered next-steps list.
useWhen: A form or multi-step flow has just completed successfully and the user needs confirmation plus a clear path forward.
Onboarding or setup has finished and you want to guide the user through a short list of next actions.
avoidWhen: The confirmation is specifically for a passwordless/magic-link auth flow — use magic-link-sent-state instead, since it needs email-echo and resend-specific affordances this component doesn't have.
No further action is needed and the flow should auto-redirect — a full panel with buttons may be unnecessary ceremony.
responsiveBehavior: The full-page variant centers its content with a constrained message width (max-w-sm); the compact card variant is a self-contained bordered block that fits inline within a page rather than taking over the whole viewport.
accessibility: The full-page variant's heading is a real <h1> so the page has a correct document outline even though it replaces the normal route content.
The success icon is decorative (aria-hidden) in both variants — the heading and message independently convey the success state.
The numbered next-steps list uses a real ordered list (<ol>) so screen readers announce both the sequence and count of steps.
